subject: Regional edge blackout impacting Luminary Health — routing decision & exec sync
messages:
From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@luminaryhealth.com>
To: diego_fernandez@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Production latency spike & 5xx across us-west — urgent

Diego,

We started seeing a hard spike in latency and 500/502 errors for our west-coast customers starting ~08:40 PDT. Error rate is ~12% and average generation latency jumped from ~180ms to ~1.8s. This is impacting checkout on our patient portal — orders are timing out.

We have a live incident and are paging your PD on-call but wanted to escalate directly to you as our account owner. Can Redwood force a cross-region reroute away from us-west (us-west2) to us-east2 immediately? We need an ETA for a mitigation and an estimate for how long traffic should remain pinned.

I attached a couple of logs and a screenshot of the 500s from our side.

Thanks,
Alex Turner
Sr. SRE, Luminary Health
ops@luminaryhealth.com
Attachment: screenshot-500s.png

From: diego_fernandez@redwood.ai
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@luminaryhealth.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 09:25:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Production latency spike & 5xx across us-west — urgent

Alex — thanks for the heads up and the screenshots. I'm escalating this to infra and network. We're opening an internal PD incident (PD-44219) and will triage root cause; initial telemetry shows elevated 5xx rates on our us-west2 edge cluster.

Immediate plan (0-30m):
- Authorize a targeted cross-region reroute to us-east2 for Luminary's traffic only (we'll keep other customers on existing routing to avoid cascading).
- Enable prefix KV cache warm-up and a conservative batching policy for your routes to reduce transient latency.
- Keep your TTLs and session affinity for 15 mins post-reroute.

I'm copying Vanessa (routing lead) and Marissa (CS lead) for approval on reroute and customer comms. Can we do the reroute now? We will attach a playbook and KPI snapshot after the switch.

— Diego
Diego Fernandez
Enterprise Account Lead — Redwood Inference

From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
To: diego_fernandez@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 09:31:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Production latency spike & 5xx across us-west — urgent

Diego/Marissa — I recommend we proceed with a scoped reroute to us-east2 now. Notes: 1) we will divert only Luminary's edge routes to the healthy cluster; 2) expected median latency increase for some payloads ~120–250ms (due to cross-region RTT) but 5xx should drop to <1% once connections drain; 3) I will trigger automatic fallback to the original cluster if error rate doesn't improve inside 12 minutes.

I've uploaded the immediate steps to the shared drive and attach the reroute playbook. We'll need service-owner sign-off for any extended (>2 hours) pinning.

Attachment: reroute-playbook.pdf
— Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz
Routing & Ops Manager — Redwood Inference

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: diego_fernandez@redwood.ai, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Cc: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 09:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Production latency spike & 5xx across us-west — urgent

Diego — please go ahead. Also escalating to CS leadership and recommending an exec-level comms path for Luminary — they are on a fast-moving P0 and will expect credits if SLA impacts continue. Soojin, can you prepare a short customer statement and offer a 1-hour briefing once we stabilize?

I'll draft the customer note and the proposed goodwill credit pending post-incident review. Keep me posted on ETA for improvement.

— Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Customer Success Manager — Redwood Inference

From: diego_fernandez@redwood.ai
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@luminaryhealth.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Action taken: scoped reroute to us-east2 initiated (PD-44219)

Alex — we initiated the scoped reroute at 10:00 PDT and started draining your edge sessions from us-west2. Early telemetry: error rate dropped from ~12% to ~2.1% within 5 minutes; median latency improved from 1.8s to ~620ms. We're continuing to monitor and will attach a KPI snapshot in 15 minutes.

Next steps:
- If error rate stays <3% for 12 minutes we will keep traffic on us-east2 for 2 hours and then reassess.
- If any customer-visible regressions appear (increased latency errors or auth/session issues) we will roll back immediately.

Links: PD incident: https://pagerduty.com/incidents/PD-44219
Drive folder: https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/incident-2027-06-01
Attachment: kpi-snapshot.csv

Diego
